description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single attacks (3.50 each) capped at 19999, causes [DEF, RES and MND -50% (8s)] if 0-3 FF14 allies are alive, grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +15% (8s)] to all allies if 4+ FF14 allies are alive, grants [Twin Element Mode II (Lightning, Wind)], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Scion Red Mage Mode I (Alisaie)], [Wind/Lightning Resonance +5% Boost] and [Dual Black Mana Ability Counter] to the user

description.name: Twin Element Mode II (Lightning, Wind)
description.text: Grants [Attach Lightning with Stacking]/[Attach Wind with Stacking] after using a Lightning/Wind ability

description.name: Dual Awoken Scion Red Mage Mode I (Alisaie)
description.text: Black Magic and White Magic abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Black Magic and White Magic abilities trigger 2 additional times, grants Dual Black Mana +1 to the user after using Black Magic and White Magic abilities, casts Dual Enchanted Riposte when removed

description.name: Wind/Lightning Resonance +5% Boost
description.text: Wind and Lightning abilities deal 5% more damage

description.name: Dual Black Mana Ability Counter
description.text: Keeps track of the number of Black Magic or White Magic abilities used, removed if the character hasn't [Dual Awoken Scion Red Mage Mode I (Alisaie)]

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Scion Red Mage Mode II (Alisaie)], removes [Dual Awoken Scion Red Mage Mode I (Alisaie)]
